hook_stat.sub: Berkshire Hathaway stock buybacks in the third quarter — more than double the $4.5 billion in the second quarter

stats.label: Fall in third-quarter operating earnings, to $12.705 billion
Drop in insurance underwriting profit, to $1.352 billion
Cash and equivalents including Treasury bills at the end of September

diaspora_bullets: Berkshire shares rose more than 5% this week while the S&P 500 fell almost 2.7%
It was Greg Abel's third quarter as chief executive after taking over from Warren Buffett in January
news_summary: Berkshire Hathaway's third-quarter operating earnings fell 5.8% to $12.705 billion as insurance underwriting profit fell 43%, while the company bought back about $9.6 billion of its own stock.
payoff: Buybacks may not keep this pace — Berkshire is price-sensitive, and October buying already slowed as the share price rose.
